subject: Role bundling & temporary hiring gate — request for exception
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: bundle two mid-senior backend reqs into a single fullstack req (comp band alignment)

Team —

Quick ask. We have two open backend requisitions (BE-348 & BE-352) that are competing for the same small candidate pool and sit at the same comp band (Band 4). Given budget pressure and overlapping scope for the next 6 months, I propose we: 

- Pause BE-352 and convert BE-348 into a bundled Fullstack (BE-FS-360) that covers the immediate product priorities (inference infra + small UI/ops).
- Re-scope the role to widen the candidate funnel (frontend + backend) and bump to Band 5 for market parity.

Why this helps: fewer hires, faster time-to-impact, and we preserve the critical infra skillset while widening sourcing options. Tradeoff: slightly higher comp per hire but net headcount savings.

Attached: reqs_summary.xlsx (headcount delta) and comp_band_snapshot.pdf.

Request: Can People Ops/Comp confirm whether the Band 5 shift is feasible with our current compensation envelope and whether we can process BE-348 as an exemption to the temporary hiring gate if approved? Also copying Aditya to flag any cross-team sales/partner dependencies.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

(attachment: reqs_summary.xlsx, comp_band_snapshot.pdf)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: bundle two mid-senior backend reqs into a single fullstack req (comp band alignment)

Thanks Marcus — good summary. A few quick points: 

1) Please send a headcount mapping that shows where the two current reqs sit against the org chart (who will absorb which responsibilities) and the expected time-to-fill for the bundled FS role. I want to see the 6- and 12-month view.
2) Include the net OTE / offer band delta (per hire) and the total run-rate impact for FY27.
3) We have a temporary hiring gate in effect for the rest of Q4 — exceptions are evaluated but need a clear business case.

Im copying Lauren for People Ops confirmation. If People Ops is comfortable with the Band 5 ask AND Finance signs off on run-rate, Im happy to recommend an exception for a single mission-critical hire.

Also, loop in TalentEdge (samantha@talentedge.co) if you want them to re-target search to the new bundled profile — keep the vendor in the thread.

-Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Product Ops
Redwood Inference

(attachment requested: headcount_mapping.csv)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, TalentEdge <samantha@talentedge.co>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2026 08:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: bundle two mid-senior backend reqs into a single fullstack req (comp band alignment)

Thanks for the clear ask. From People Ops perspective: 

- Comp band: moving this position to Band 5 is possible but will require sign-off from Compensation (Ive asked comp to review the attached snapshot). For any Band 5 offer above midpoint well need VP approval.
- Hiring gate: temporary freeze remains through 2026-Q4. Were triaging exceptions for roles that are materially time-sensitive to revenue, security, or legal compliance. Please include a concise 1-page business rationale for the exception (impact if we dont hire vs. impact if we shift resources internally).
- Internal redeploy: before approving an exception, we expect you to certify internal backfills have been considered — list any internal transfers or reassignments.

If you can send the headcount mapping and a short business rationale by EOD Wednesday, well route for expedited review. Finance will need the run-rate delta (total comp + benefits per FTE) and an updated hiring plan in Workday (Ill help with the Workday ticket).

One other practical note for TalentEdge: if we do a bundled req, please re-run the outreach with the broader skillset and confirm market-relevant comps for Band 5.

- Lauren
Lauren Bishop
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference

(attachments referenced: comp_band_snapshot.pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, TalentEdge <samantha@talentedge.co>, FinanceOps <procure@vendorcorp.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: bundle two mid-senior backend reqs into a single fullstack req (comp band alignment)

Vanessa / Lauren —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is the headcount_mapping.csv and a one-page business rationale (pasted below for convenience). High level: bundling reduces hires by 1 FTE in FY27 and accelerates delivery on the inference caching work by ~8 weeks; Band 5 uplift increases OTE by ~12% per hire but net-run-rate still lower due to 1 fewer hire.

Business rationale (summary):
- Problem: BE-352 and BE-348 are duplicative for next 6 months; both compete for senior infra candidates.
- Proposal: Pause BE-352, convert BE-348 to BE-FS-360 (fullstack) with Band 5 compensation.
- Impact if we dont: delayed infra rollout impacting product SLAs and customer onboarding schedule; potential revenue delay for two partner onboarding pipelines (estimated 2-3 weeks each).
- Internal mitigations: two contractors (already budgeted) will cover urgent maintenance; planned internal rotation (SRE->serving runtime) for 3 months to cover key gaps.

Requested approvals: 
1) People Ops sign-off on Band 5 for BE-FS-360 (VP approval path acknowledged).
2) Hiring gate exception for 1 mission-critical hire to be processed this week.

If comp and finance confirm numbers, Ill ask TalentEdge to restart outreach with the bundled brief.

Appreciate the help — happy to jump on a 20m sync if needed.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
